statement: For the integer sequence a_0=1 and a_{n+1}=a_n^2+2 for every n>=0, q=108099707 is prime, satisfies 1<q<a_22, and divides a_22; consequently a_22 is composite. No claim is made about the complete factorization or cofactor of a_22, any a_n for n>22, or novelty or priority.
contribution: An explicit proper prime divisor of a_22 with two deterministic primality verifications (a Pocklington certificate and independent exhaustive trial division) and a complete exact 22-step modular-recursion certificate, thereby resolving the frozen constructive problem without claiming novelty.
